title: Tool-Making Crows
summary: A one-minute clip of the New Caledonian crow Betty bending a straight wire into a hook to retrieve food from a tube. It comes from a 2002 Science study on tool-making in crows.
why: HN links it as the clearest demonstration that crows can fashion tools.

quote.text: A crow, given food in a thin cylinder and a piece of wire, bends the wire into a hook and pulls the food out.
